description: Test file for the React 'Controls' component, validating button enabling/disabling and callback invocations based on permissions and user interactions.

methods.name: test('buttons are disabled/enabled based on permissions')
methods.description: Tests that the Reset, Export, and Jump buttons are disabled or enabled based on the 'permissions' prop and that the export callback is called when the export button is clicked.

methods.name: test('invokes onReset and onJump when enabled')
methods.description: Tests that clicking the Reset button calls 'onReset' and clicking a Jump button calls 'onJump' with the correct index when the permissions allow.
